What's New in SimpleCommander (formerly TK-mac)

Helping you keep your Mac fast and healthy. (v1.6 - 4 October 2026)

  • 🚀 Rebranded to SimpleCommander: TK-mac has been officially renamed to SimpleCommander, complete with a brand new app icon and a refined identity. Please Check out the new website:www.simplecommander.com
  • 🍏 macOS Golden Gate Support: Added full compatibility and seamless support for the upcoming macOS Golden Gate.
  • 🔒 App Lock Protection: Secure individual applications using Touch ID or custom Keychain passwords, complete with customizable re-lock grace periods.
  • 🛡️ Watchdog Protection: The new Anti Force Quit system instantly restarts the app if it gets forcefully closed, keeping your App Lock protection continuous and resilient.
  • 📡 Network Devices Scanner: Easily discover and view all devices currently connected to your local network directly within the app.
  • 🎛️ Remote Hardware Control: Adjust your Mac's volume and screen brightness right from your phone using the remote web dashboard.
  • 📸 Remote Screenshots: Capture exactly what's on your Mac's screen with a single tap from the remote web dashboard.
  • ⏱️ Built-in & Remote Speed Test: Accurately measure your Mac's internet performance directly from the dashboard and remote web dashboard, powered securely by M-Lab's open-source infrastructure.
  • 🌐 Network Menu Bar: Keep an eye on your live upload and download speeds, straight from your Mac's menu bar.
  • 🔒 Remote Mac Locking: You can now instantly lock your computer remotely using your phone via the remote access dashboard.
  • ✨ Performance & UI Enhancements: Refined visual elements for a cleaner native macOS experience, alongside major under-the-hood optimizations and bug fixes for speed, stability, and polish.
